== Biography ==
Isabella was born about 1834. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-2603|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Lamb-11245|Mary Lamb]].  She arrived in Wellington with her parents in 1841.

She married Donald Cameron in 1853 in New Zealand. <ref>"New Zealand, Civil Records Indexes, 1800-1966," database, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:Q24J-JBZB : 4 October 2016), Donald Cameron and Isabella Glasgow, 1853; citing Marriage, New Zealand, registration number 1853/994, Archives of New Zealand, Wellington.</ref>

They were the parents of six sons.

After the death of Donald, she married William Lowes, a widower, and at one time Mayor of Masterton, in 1868.<ref name="marriage">"Births, Deaths & Marriages Online", [digital index], New Zealand Department of Internal Affairs (www.bdmhistoricalrecords.dia.govt.nz), Marriage Registration of William Lowes and Isabella Cameron ; citing Marriage Certificate 1868/7268 .</ref> 

She and William had two daughters.

She was widowed a second time in 1901.

She passed away in 1920 and is buried in Archer Street cemetery.
 <ref name="death"> "Births, Deaths & Marriages Online", [digital index], New Zealand Department of Internal Affairs (www.bdmhistoricalrecords.dia.govt.nz), Death Registration of Isabella Lowes, aged at death 86Y; citing Death Certificate 1920/3195 .</ref>

=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2603]] is assessed at 83% (probable). The held account assigns Isabella (Glasgow) Lowes to Robert Glasgow and Mary Lamb in the Bombay/Turakina family. Isabella’s detailed later life and Bombay grouping support the family account; the 1841 arrival claim conflicts with the 1842 sailing category.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Inspect the 1842 Bombay passenger family list and the child’s NZ death certificate parent fields.
